lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters positioned in longitudinal rows along the lateral flank posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Intermittent vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to form a coarse rectilinear grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper lateral flank, exhibiting high-contrast vertical luminance gradients with light superior edges and dark inferior shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Scattered high-luminance blobs of low density observed on the basal and mid-regions of the first dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.
